prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on your case facts, injuries, how much fault/insurance is involved, whether you’ll need to sue, and how comfortable you feel with the lawyer.

How to find the best attorney for your case
- Hire a lawyer who focuses on car-accident/personal-injury cases and has trial experience (not a generalist).  
- Look for a proven track record of recovery in similar cases and courtroom experience if the insurer won’t settle.  
- Confirm they have the resources (investigators, medical experts) to handle your case.  
- Ask about their fee structure (usually contingency: no fee unless you recover, and ask about costs).  
- Check client reviews, peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell AV ratings), and disciplinary history with the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission.  
- You should feel comfortable communicating with them and getting timely updates.

Well-known Chicago plaintiff firms you can start with
(These are reputable firms that commonly handle serious car-crash claims; you should interview a few to see which is right for you.)
- Clifford Law Offices  
- Corboy & Demetrio  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Power Rogers & Smith  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard

What to do next
- Get free consultations with 2–3 firms.  
- Ask the questions below during consultations (sample list follows).  
- Compare answers, comfort level, and willingness to try the case in court if necessary.

Sample questions to ask in a consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?  
- Who will actually handle my case day-to-day (attorney or paralegal)?  
- Do you try cases in court or mostly settle?  
- What is your contingency fee and what costs will I be responsible for?  
- How long do you expect my case to take?  
- How will you communicate with me and how often?  
- What evidence will you need from me? Can you help get medical care/records?

If you want, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and a few details about the crash (date, injuries, insurance situation) and I can compile a short list of local attorneys and what to ask each of them.
